violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026

The door to the outside, located in the front is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quat and chlorine sanitizing solution for the 3 bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
The ceiling tiles throughout are in poor repair (previous water damage). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/31/2026
